items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: Faye Adams, Faye Adams was one of the ladies. And this other lady, she was recording on Herald. She's a very, she's a good looking lady, black boy. She's dark boy. She's pretty. And she was a perfect lady. She was working the show with us.

ctx.x: Do you remember what the years that was?

1957, 56, it's the end of 56. 57 going into some parts of 58. Now what happened, what her name was, not, Faye Adams, Faye Adams was one of the ladies. And this other lady, she was recording on Herald. She's a very, she's a good looking lady, black boy. She's dark boy. She's pretty. And she was a perfect lady. She was working the show with us. And she said, man, I can't understand how you can get so much feeling into your singing, sitting down. And you know, well she admired me, and I admired her for her…
